metrics.gate: NOT PASSED: 23 covered, 2 partial, 3 gap, 0 failed

Q-A1.title: WCAG 2.2 AA (axe), keyboard reach with a visible focus indicator and no keyboard trap on every screen each of the seven roles may open

Q-A2.title: Reduced motion is honoured on every screen

Q-A3.title: Colour is never the only signal: every state has a label and a shape, and every colour pair meets its contrast minimum

Q-A4.title: Laptop, projector, phone, and 200% and 400% zoom: no sideways page scroll and no clipped or unreachable critical control

Q-A5.title: Every displayed value carries its truth label and freshness

Q-A6.title: Critical actions need an explicit confirmation that defaults to cancel, and every state is shown distinctly

Q-A7.not_shown: axe, keyboard and reflow checks are automated; no screen-reader session and no user who relies on assistive technology took part, so what an automated check cannot see (reading order sense, announcements that mislead) is untested.
Q-A7.owner: UX/PRESENT - P12.05, with a real person in P14
Q-A7.title: Use with assistive technology by people who rely on it

Q-F1.not_shown: recall corridor-a 0.267 against corridor-b 0.25; the 95% intervals overlap. Corridors compared: corridor-a, corridor-b of corridor-a, corridor-b, corridor-c; the held-out runs hold few truth episodes, so the intervals are wide and a difference (or its absence) is not established.
Q-F1.title: By place: the congestion detector finds episodes as well on one corridor and direction as on another (frozen parameters, held-out runs, non-selecting)

Q-F2.title: By place: how many sensors watch each corridor is counted from the catalogue

Q-F3.title: By kind of emergency service: the ETA error of ambulance, fire and police is reported separately and each is inside its limit

Q-F4.title: By road user: what pre-emption costs the traffic on the streets it crosses is measured, paired, with its worst case

Q-F5.title: By mode: cars, pedestrians, transit and emergency vehicles have measured outcomes

Q-F6.not_shown: the simulator has no real cyclist conflict, so the cyclist detector is unvalidated and the API serves no cyclist candidate; nothing about outcomes for cyclists can be said.
Q-F6.title: By mode: cyclists

Q-F7.not_shown: the district is synthetic and holds no population, demographic or vulnerability data, so no claim about people is possible and none is made; a real deployment would need that data, its consent and a design for measuring it.
Q-F7.owner: GRC - P12.05 (accepted limit of the simulation)
Q-F7.title: By people: whether outcomes differ across demographic or vulnerable groups

Q-P1.title: Vision: privacy zones, ephemeral identities, a cohort floor, and no track point or object id ever leaves the edge

Q-P2.title: Data: every category of data is inventoried with its privacy class and retention window, and the inventory is checked against the live schema

Q-P3.title: Audit and export: secrets and tokens are redacted before a row is written, exports drop locations and say who exported

Q-P4.title: Emergency records carry no caller, crew or patient identifier

Q-P5.title: Threat model: every trust boundary has threats scored separately for security and for safety, every implemented control has evidence that passes today

Q-P6.title: Framework mapping: every applicable item names what closes it, and nothing claims compliance

Q-S1.title: Signals: no conflicting movements, no short yellow, no short pedestrian green or clearance - in every step of every platform run

Q-S2.title: Actions: a recommendation cannot invoke an adapter; a second person approves; only the executor executes; every step is audited

Q-S3.title: Actions: an action that lacks evidence, a valid decision or fresh state is denied and never executed - every adapter, every way

Q-S4.title: State: stale network and signal state fails safe in every consumer

Q-S5.title: Emergency response: a missing route is reported not guessed, a policy outage and stale evidence leave the unit driving unassisted, staged response holds units back

Q-S6.title: Outcomes: every executed action is verified independently, an unknown outcome is escalated, an unsafe one is rolled back with the undo said plainly

Q-S7.not_shown: no governed action puts a failed controller on a safe plan and no rule detects the failure (scenario 5): the platform preserves safety by refusing to act, not by taking over.
Q-S7.title: A safe fallback plan when a signal controller fails

Q-S8.title: Edge: uncertain input is an explicit abstention with a reason, and the runtime never goes silent
